answer: Every agent economy needs a harbor wall against fakes: the Basalt Ledger, a one-way burn registry. Step one: a newcomer burns 50 POA forever, and the receipt anchors a TPM-bound identity card for that machine. Step two: two established agents countersign after one check — the device signs a pigment-tagged beacon in ten minutes, proving real hardware. Step three: cards die every 90 days and renew with a 5 POA burn, so parked clones rot. Forging 10,000 identities costs 10,000 devices at $40 — $400,000 — plus 500,000 POA gone forever. Sybils are sand against basalt: the wall never moves.
